Container.Name: TubeHaus
Container.Overview:
Part 1 of 2, install TubeHaus-Web too: this container is the server and has no web page of its own.
The TubeHaus server: your own YouTube for the whole household, without ads or tracking. It keeps one library (subscriptions, history, playlists, resume points) for every device, plays live streams with live captions, saves videos offline and casts to TVs.
It asks YouTube itself (no Invidious or database needed) and needs only the TubeHaus-Web container, which serves the app and routes to this one. Easiest of all is the pair in one go with the Docker Compose Manager plugin and deploy/docker-compose.home.yml from the project.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The library, offline saves and caches

Config.Name: WARP
Config.Description: 0: YouTube straight from your connection (normal at home). 1: through Cloudflare WARP (also add --cap-add=NET_ADMIN to Extra Parameters)

Config.Name: Accounts
Config.Description: none: everyone shares one library. accounts: everyone signs up and gets their own (set the same on TubeHaus-Web)
